Indian shooters win silver at Asian Games

India's men's 10m air rifle team, comprising Rudrankksh Patil, Himanshu Dhillon, and Parth Mane, won a silver medal at the Asian Games. Dhillon won silver in the individual event, while Rudrankksh Patil secured a bronze. This brings India's total shooting medal tally at the games to three.
